name: High School DxD
source:
Based on the Anime with the Same Name, Which was Based on a Light novel by Ishibumi Ichiei with Illustrations by Zero Miyama.

Hyoudou Issei, a simple-minded, lecherous second-year high school student is killed by an innocent-looking beautiful girl on his very first date. Issei is reincarnated as a devil, with the help of Rias Gremory, and so ends up as her Pawn from then on. Gremory is not only the president of the Occult Research Club, and the prettiest girl on campus, but also a high-ranking devil herself.

Are Issei's days without female companionship finally over, or will life after death turn out to be a lot more complicated than he ever imagined?

[From [url=https://anidb.net/perl-bin/animedb.pl?show=anime&aid=8660]AniDB[/url]]

A Turn-based RPG Game based on the Events of the First Season of the Anime, Described as an "erotic battle adventure" The Game Features a Visual Novel-like Gameplay system.
translation:
本作改编自动画《恶魔高校D×D》；动画改编自石踏一荣创作、美山零插画的同名轻小说。

兵藤一诚是一名头脑简单又好色的高二学生，第一次约会就被一名看似清纯漂亮的女孩杀死。在莉雅丝·吉蒙里的帮助下，一诚转生为恶魔，从此成为她的眷属。吉蒙里不仅是神秘学研究社社长、校园里最漂亮的女孩，还是一名地位显赫的恶魔。

一诚不再有女性陪伴的日子终于结束了吗？还是说，死后的生活会比他想象中更加复杂？

这是一款根据动画第一季剧情改编的回合制RPG，被称为“色情战斗冒险”。游戏采用类似视觉小说的玩法系统。
